_doc: cloud-android-density-guard policy: the fleet's Compose hosts are dense and own window insets ONCE. Everything the guard knows is here. scan_roots: every Compose app and lib of the fleet except the three skip_dirs below (Matrix, Vault, Notes: not on the dense Material theme, see skip_dirs). Apps with their own Typography (Writer, Gallery, Drive, Search, Calc, Tools) are in scope: they keep their own scale but must drop the fixed lineHeight / letterSpacing. ac_cloud-store/web is the Kotlin/Wasm page (CloudKitTheme). rule_allow for scaffold_without_insets / nested_safe_drawing lists the STANDALONE Compose apps (Writer, Gallery, Drive, Search): each owns its Activity window and draws its own Scaffold / system-bar padding with no FleetChrome / BottomNavHost host above it, so those two host-stacking rules do not describe them (the typography and theme rules still do). MinimalistBlackFragment is the launcher home: no host above it, so it is the one owner of its insets. compose_roots: a ComposeView / setContent root in the SuperApp must sit under the dense theme (a file that builds one names CloudKitTheme / KitDenseMaterial / kitComposeView / KitComposeFragment).

bare_material_theme.why: MaterialTheme(colorScheme = ...) without typography = kitTypography() hands every Text a fixed 24.sp bodyLarge line and every Material control a 48dp floor: the 'huge padding' after the Compose conversions. Use CloudKitTheme or KitDenseMaterial; an app with its own Typography names `typography =`.

scaffold_without_insets.why: Scaffold applies WindowInsets.systemBars to its content by default; inside a host that already clears the bars (FleetChrome + AppTopBarScaffold / BottomNavHost) that is a second copy of the same padding. Pass contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0) or the one slice you own.

stock_typography.why: A bare Typography() keeps Material's fixed lineHeight (bodyLarge 24.sp) and 0.5.sp letterSpacing, which every dense Text inherits: the 'huge padding'. Use kitTypography(), or take Typography() through a .dense*()/copy that sets lineHeight and letterSpacing to TextUnit.Unspecified.

nested_safe_drawing.why: safeDrawing / systemBars padding is the window host's job exactly once (AppTopBarScaffold's host takes statusBarsPadding; BottomNavHost clears the bottom). A page that takes it again stacks both.

bare_material_button.why: Material3's Button/OutlinedButton/TextButton/FilledTonalButton carry a fixed defaultMinSize(58dp x 40dp) and 24dp x 8dp padding that NO theme can shrink: the owner's 'Configs buttons are STILL huge' (4th report, 2026-10-17). Use libs:ui-kit KitButton / KitOutlinedButton / KitTextButton / KitTonalButton (30dp, 10x4dp, labelMedium). Scoped to the Configs pages and the libs they draw (rule_scope); widen the scope as other apps convert.

compose_roots.why: A ComposeView / setContent root in the SuperApp that is not under CloudKitTheme (kitComposeView, KitComposeFragment) or KitDenseMaterial gets a bare Material theme: every Text a fixed 24.sp line and every control a 48dp floor, the 'buttons are huge' regression. Host it with kitComposeView(palette) { .. } or wrap its content in CloudKitTheme.

rule_scope._doc: A rule named here applies ONLY under these path prefixes (every other rule applies to all scan_roots).
